snippet.title: [Announcement Trailer] Harlequinade - Timeloop Horror Otome Visual Novel Teaser
snippet.description:
Tired from your studies, your friends drag you out for a night of fun out at a traveling carnival. But for some reason, you can't help but feel the sense of déjà vu...
Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a day that keeps going on forever—unless you find out how to stop it for good with the help of the clowns stuck at the carnival with you.

The full game will feature:
- ability to customize your protagonist from 2 character looks with a changeable name and pronouns
- 2 romanceable male leads at the carnival, the Harlequin and the Pierrot
- lots, and lots, and lots of ways to die, with several permanent endings

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4333920/Harlequinade/

Animation illustration done by Numanne. Ending Harlequin artwork by Erika. Music by Beemyu.

We are an otome & boys love visual novel development studio. Follow our newsletter for game updates: https://crystalgameworks.com/newsletter/
